svg.text: E-B Alles ist Geschirr — every food-contact part is a dish, washed in 3 minutes
Trays are the work surface, tools are steel parts on a stem; a small rack washer washes as the machine goes.
about 17 actuators: 6-axis gantry, wall drives, ram, washer
FRONT VIEW of the bay, 0.6 px per mm (rack station drawn shortened)
benches on load cells + vibrators; floor 5° to drain
next tray from the clean store
chop inside the tray: soil stays in the ware

g.text: The gripper never gets dirty: no gripper wash.
Used tool is dropped into the rack; collar
is washed with the tool. 14 tools × 2 sets.

svg.text: Steel ware dries by its own heat

g.text: 1 kg tray at 80 °C stores ~25 kJ above 30 °C:
evaporates 10 g; the air knife leaves < 5 g.
Thin knives (150 g) rely on the air knife.
HDPE board + silicone mat: 5 min warm air.
1 · cold mains pre-spray 15 s, 1 L to drain: scraps to the 2 mm strainer (no baked-on protein)
5 · leaves at ~75 °C, camera (white + UV-A) checks each item → clean store
rack waits as the parking place for used ware (wet parking)
dirty door opens: rack shuttles in

svg.text: 1/7 Box tilts at the dock: zucchini into the steel tray on bench 1, weighed by its load cell
2/7 Gantry grips the knife stem by its knob; the knife cuts inside the tray
3/7 Used knife goes straight into the wash rack — that is its parking place
4/7 Wrist lifts the tray and tips it over its corner spout into the pot
5/7 Empty tray into the rack too; nothing fixed in the bay touched food
6/7 Rack washer: cold pre-spray, 60 °C wash, 85 °C rinse, air knife — 3–4 min per rack
7/7 Hot steel leaves dry by its own heat; camera check; into the clean store
